title: 22章：是非恩怨与对错
content_zh:
为首的护国军将官看着张寰带人围了上来，挥手示意队伍停止前进，主动上前行了一个军礼后，说道：“诸位老乡，你们这是何意？”

    像是在问张寰的举动，又像是在问他们聚集是为了什么，而今张荼又是在众目睽睽下悍然杀人，自是引起了护国军官的反感。

    但能做到将官的心思又岂是简单，而今天下骤变，需要他们的地方太多了，而如今执法机构大多已经瘫痪，而他们也没有执法权，所以本打算睁一只眼闭一只眼，可是谁曾想，张荼当着他们的面悍然杀人，而张寰又是率众围了上来。

    而就在这时，护国军中发生了简短且混乱的骚动，只见一个小子越众而出，手中的自动步枪连贯的拉栓上膛，径直指着张寰等人，口中厉喝道：“都给我滚开，交出那个杀人凶手！杀人偿命，天经地义！”

    而这时，为首的护国军将官面色顿时铁青，而就在这时，张寰等人的脸色也是骤变，但是出乎那么小兵想象的是，张寰等人非但没有推开，反而是缓缓地向前压了上来。

    什么时候，护国军的枪口，开始对着人民了？

    “嘭！”

    为首的将官一脚踹在了小兵身上，顿时将那人踹了一个趔趄，随后一个不稳趴在了地上，口中怒吼着：“翻天了，给我把枪缴了。”

    与此同时，队伍中有人越众而出，将那小兵压着，可是为首将官仍觉得怒气难平，上前便是“啪啪”两个耳刮子。

    “瞎了你的眼，护国军的枪口，是对准谁的？谁他妈给你的胆子？啊？”

    “他妈的，带下去，要是说不出个所以然，删除军籍，放逐回乡。”

    “是！”

    对于一名护国军来说，删除军籍，放逐回乡。已经是天大的惩罚，要知道杀人诛心，而将官如此做，是从根本上否定其信仰，毁灭其灵魂，抹灭掉此人青春所有的汗水和付出。

    果不其然，那小兵闻言之后，顿时脸色苍白，嘴唇蠕动一番后，终究是什么话语没有讲出，任由被人带了下去。

    为首将官看向了张寰，双手有些紧张地搓了搓，面色多少有些尴尬。

    而此时，张家众人已经停止了脚步。

    张寰此时开口说道：“将军如何称呼？我们兄弟之所以冒昧地拦住将军，没有他意，只为含冤而来……”

    为首将官指了指后方的张荼，没有郁结在了一起，终于说道：“将军不敢称，我叫徐团集，奉命救援琅琊市。”

    “嗯，那人不是你们本家兄弟？恕我直言，老乡，我们没有执法权……我们最多也就是帮你们调解，而今，你也看到了，已经超过了我的能力范围，我们……我们有着我们自己的纪律。”

    说到最后，徐团集像是不好意思一般，声音慢慢小了下去。

    张寰闻言，不禁一阵苦笑，说道：“如今世道，我们上哪去找执法机构去？而你们，则是我们最后也是最大的依靠不是么？若是你们没有办法为我们主持公道，我们只有用我们自己的方式去解决了。唉……”

    一声沉重的叹息，众人面色的黯淡，无不像是一记重拳一般，轰击在徐团集的胸口，可是他也很无奈，想要为眼前的老乡出头，可是纪律不允许。

    就在这时，张荼手持长枪施施然地走了过来，而王家众人则是看着倒地的王茂以及围起来的护国军等人，一时间倒是不言不语。
content_en:
The leading general of the National Defense Army saw Zhang Huan and his people surrounding him, waved his hand to signal the team to stop advancing, took the initiative to step forward and performed a military salute, and said, "Fellow fellows, what do you mean by this?"

    It seemed as if he was asking about Zhang Huan's actions, or why they gathered together. Now Zhang Tu was brazenly killing people in full view of the public, which naturally aroused the disgust of the officers protecting the country.

    But how can a general's mind be simple? Today's world has changed suddenly, and there are too many places where they are needed. Nowadays, most law enforcement agencies have been paralyzed, and they have no law enforcement power, so they originally planned to turn a blind eye, but who would have thought that Zhang Tu killed people brazenly in front of them, and Zhang Huan led the crowd to surround them.

    At this moment, a brief and chaotic commotion broke out in the National Guard Army. A boy emerged from the crowd. The automatic rifle in his hand was unloaded and pointed directly at Zhang Huan and others. He shouted: "Get out of here and hand over the murderer! Murder must be punished with life. It is only right!"

    At this time, the face of the leading general of the National Defense Army suddenly turned livid, and at this moment, the expressions of Zhang Huan and others also changed suddenly. But beyond the imagination of such a small soldier, Zhang Huan and others, instead of pushing away, slowly pressed forward.

    When did the National Protectorate's guns start pointing at the people?

    "Bang!"

    The leading general kicked the soldier, causing him to stagger, and then he fell unsteadily to the ground, roaring: "This is a big deal, hand over the gun to me."

    At the same time, someone from the team came out and suppressed the soldier, but the leading general still felt that his anger could not be calmed down, so he stepped forward and slapped his ears twice.

    "Blinding your eyes, who are the National Guards Army's guns aimed at? Who the hell gave you the courage? Huh?"

    "Fuck him, take him down. If he can't explain why, his military status will be deleted and he will be exiled back to his hometown."

    "Yes!"

    For a national protector, his military status is deleted and he is exiled back to his hometown. It is already a huge punishment. You must know that killing someone is heartbreaking, but for a general to do this, he is fundamentally denying his faith, destroying his soul, and wiping out all the sweat and dedication of this person's youth.

    As expected, after hearing the words, the soldier's face suddenly turned pale, and after squirming his lips, he finally did not say anything and allowed himself to be taken away.

    The leading general looked at Zhang Huan, rubbed his hands nervously, and looked somewhat embarrassed.

    At this time, everyone in the Zhang family had stopped.

    Zhang Huan said at this time: "What do you call the general? The reason why our brothers took the liberty to stop the general has no other intention and just came here to express injustice..."

    The leading general pointed to Zhang Tu behind him, and finally said, "General, I dare not call you. My name is Xu Tuanji, and I have been ordered to rescue Langya City."

    "Well, that person is not your brother? With all due respect, fellow, we have no law enforcement power... The most we can do is help you mediate. Now, as you can see, it is beyond my ability. We... we have our own discipline."

    At the end of the sentence, Xu Tuanji seemed to be embarrassed and his voice slowly became quieter.

    Hearing this, Zhang Huan couldn't help but smile bitterly and said: "In today's world, where are we going to find law enforcement agencies? And you are our last and biggest support, aren't you? If you can't bring justice to us, we will have to solve it in our own way. Sigh..."

    There was a heavy sigh and the gloomy expressions on everyone's faces, all like a heavy punch hitting Xu Tuanji's chest, but he was also helpless and wanted to stand up for the fellow villagers in front of him, but the discipline did not allow it.

    At this moment, Zhang Tu came over calmly with a spear in hand, while everyone in the Wang family looked at Wang Mao who fell to the ground and the surrounding National Defense Army and others, and remained silent for a while.
title_en: Chapter 22: Right and wrong, grudges and right and wrong
